content:
ashley: Customer reports 400 from /v1/rerank. They say payload looks correct client-side but our prod logs show an empty body when it reached the gateway.

ashley: Repro steps they provided:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary '{"items":[{"id":"1","query":"Q"}],"candidates":[],"top_k":1}'
```

ashley: They mentioned a JS SDK (2.3.1) behind an nginx proxy which uses proxy_buffering and compression middleware. They claim the SDK serialized OK but the proxy may be altering headers.

omar: @ashley can you paste the raw request headers/body we logged in prod? content-length or transfer-encoding? :thinking:

ashley: Prod ingress snapshot shows:
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
content-length: 0
content-type: application/json
x-forwarded-for: 3.4.5.6
```
So the body appears blank when it hit the gateway.

eli: That matches upstream truncation. Does our JS SDK ever send chunked requests or rely on content-length? Which client version again?

ashley: js-sdk 2.3.1. The app also uses express `compression()` and an nginx proxy that may buffer/stream small requests. Customer suspects nginx sets `content-length: 0` when it buffers and then forwards.

omar: I'll try to reproduce locally with nginx config like `proxy_buffering on; proxy_buffer_size 4k;` and a minimal app that proxies to our endpoint. If the proxy strips body we should see the same 400.

support-bot: Created support ticket INF-5231 and attached the ingress header dump and customer payload.

eli: Action items: (1) Omar to repro and share nginx conf + curl to reproduce. (2) Support (Ashley) to send workaround: disable proxy buffering or ensure upstream sets correct content-length / avoid double compression. (3) SDK team to add a pre-send check in 2.x to error if body empty after serializing.

ashley: For customer response: ask them to try `proxy_buffering off;` or ensure `Content-Length` is present, and provide curl example bypassing proxy. I'll update ticket with that and link to this thread. :thumbsup:

omar: Repro in progress, will post results in INF-5231. If confirmed, we should also improve API 400 message to say "empty or truncated request body (possible upstream proxy)" and include a header snapshot in the error detail to help debugging.

ashley: Thanks — will follow up with customer after Omar confirms.
